draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.82, the 202nd-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 15th of 19 at RB. He went 119th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (202nd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 339 rushing yards in 2020, 17th of 19 RBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Jets. 51 career games and 1 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2021. Weak spots: receptions 0 (2nd percentile), broken tackles 0 (5th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 running back who played: 49 scrimmage yards against a median of 396, below the norm.
